crossRefs.note: Give ear to my words, Yahweh. Consider my meditation.
Lead me, Yahweh, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should…
Now therefore, if I have found favor in your sight, please show me your way, now, that I may know you, so that I may…
I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…
Yahweh says, “Stand in the ways and see, and ask for the old paths, ‘Where is the good way?’ and walk in it, and you…

parallels.note: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge…

translations.web: Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
translations.bsb: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
translations.kjv: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.
translations.asv: Show me thy ways, O Jehovah; Teach me thy paths.
